quality_check.description: A single vertical charcoal-style reference sheet showing rough-grained paper, concrete-like abrasion, soot bloom, rubbed graphite haze, water-stain mottling, seven muted palette swatches, industrial silhouette and architectural-line studies, machinery and decay mark-making samples, and three atmospheric lighting studies. The overall visual language is monochrome-to-muted charcoal with storm gray, black, beige, oxidized blue-green, moss green, ivory, and restrained amber accents.
violations: Extensive visible text and labels are present throughout the sheet despite the direction requiring no visible text, letters, labels, or captions.

Several lower-half samples depict recognizable industrial structures and machinery rather than remaining purely texture-and-palette abstractions, though they still function as style-reference examples.
Some lighting and stain samples have a softly digital or photographic tonal smoothness that slightly weakens the requested uniformly fibrous charcoal-paper treatment.
